reviews.t: If it works for my Icelandic it will work for you!
reviews.x: This stuff is fabulous!  I have an Icelandic who has a very thick and long tail and a mane that is about 3 times as thick as any of my non-Icelandic horses.  He also likes to roll in the mud.  I live in Wisconsin where mud season begins in February and ends...well we always  HOPE it will end before next year's snow.  Did I mention that we have a lot of red clay in our soil which dries into little bricks?  Oh and just one more thing -- my Icey's mane and tail are white!  In spite of all that, tha

reviews.t: LOVE!! And not just for horses!!!!
reviews.x: New review: Love!!! NOT JUST FOR HORSES!!! I use the detangler in my hair every day!!! Frizzy pool hair? Add this!! Want nice smooth hair!? Dime sized amount and rub through your hair!!  And for my horses?? 5 stars 5 stars!! This stuff is amazing! Used it on my pony mare and put it on her tail dry, make her hair feel like silk! Not greasy at all!! It was dry, soft and silky.

My horse is a Rocky Mountain horse with long thick hair. She comes in from the field with pieces of twigs, knots or dreadlocks if I go more than a day or so without dealing with her mane. This product line, especially the combo with polisher and conditioner, leaves her mane much more manageable than any other product. I also like how other who touch her mane say that my mares mane is softer than other horses.  I  don't her mane is intrinsically softer, it is this product line!

reviews.t: Won't go a winter without it!
reviews.x: My horse is a beautiful black and white spotted saddle horse with a long white mane and a thick black tail. In the winter, the wind whips her mane into knots. There were times when I would daily have to try to get her mane untangled, but it just never lasted. That no longer happens. When I put this product on a tangle, it easily combs out, and if I consistently use it on her mane (once a week or so), I don't have to deal with tangles at all. This is absolutely the best detangler on the market and I think I've tried them all.  My friend used it on his horse today after not being able to work on his horse's mane for months. Came untangled beautifully.

This is by far the best product I have used on my horse's mane and tail - leaves it silky smooth and debris does not get tangled. I find it does not attract dirt and dust. I have tried numerous other products and Maneley is my favorite - I have even purchased some for my other "horsey" friends to use.

reviews.t: Best detangling product you'll ever use!
reviews.x: Best detangling product I've ever used! I'm a professional dog groomer and I own a conformation-bred Golden Retriever with a long gorgeous coat. I take her on the trail with me sometimes when I ride my horses. She got into burrs really badly and this stuff makes an impossible mess brush out with relative ease! I also use it for my Friesian mare as she has very dry, itchy mane that she rubs out. If I'm consistent with using it, she doesn't rub as much and her hair is much more moist and nice. I'v

reviews.t: Actually Works - on wind knots too!
reviews.x: I have an Andalusian (horse) with an extremely course "double mane". This thing is waterproof. We love near Seattle but her neck stays dry all winter, if that tells you anything about how thick her hair is.  She loves to run, roll and, since she has dry skin, scratch her neck on trees and walls.  She gets huge tangles and wind knots all the time and I can't always shampoo her mane, like in winter or every two days. In the past, I'd just roach it every 2 years and let it regrow between (cutting o

I love this product for my horse's mane, tail & feathers (Haflinger). It has a pleasant odor, since there is no alcohol.  My horse rather likes the smell & does not do weird things with his mouth/nose which mean "too smelly".  I use it weekly and it leaves the hair silky; hair stays pretty clean and is so easy to comb. Love it!

Had a friend recommend this. As a new horse owner I was overwhelmed by the tangled mess their manes were. My friend was not wrong. It is amazing how much it helps get through all those knots and twisted messes. I will always use it. You will not regret getting it.

My husband's mare has a knack for making dreadlocks in her name. I squeeze some in my hand and run my fingers through her hair. It will last for several weeks before she has managed to start her dread do again. I rub some in her hair, untangle it, then rub it all through her name again. It also makes the yellow parts of her hair much more white. I highly recommend this product. Not sure why the stars are for warmth or sheerness. These are not really a characteristic of this product.

This is the best stuff I've ever used! Non greesy. It leaves the mane and tail tangle free and so soft for weeks! I can literally run my fingers thru my horse's tail. I hope they continue to sell it here on Amazon. I have also used it in my own hair.  I can't say enough good stuff about this product!

Absolutely the must have in your grooming arsenal for your horses! It absolutely does everything it claims the best! Use weekly to maintain results! The size of a dime does whole mane another dime for the tail!
Love this product!  I do wish it was spray in so it didn’t get all over your hands. And I wish it was cheaper. But it gets those tough tangles (dreds) out easily. Lol
I love that this keeps my haflingers thick mane and tail tangle free for days. Better than any other product I have tried (and I have tried a lot)
I received this mini bowling set with the Mane-ly Long Hair Detangler  bar code on it.  I did not receive the bottle of detangler.

reviews.t: Works great! Doesn't leave the hair greasy and makes detangling ...
reviews.x: Works great! Doesn't leave the hair greasy and makes detangling a breeze. Leaves the hair soft and silky for days after applying.

I used it on my mare Lucy, and her hair stayed shiny and untangled for days. Definitely worth it.
Not as good as Cowboy Magic detangler and Shine which I have used for years
I have a white dog and this made dirt stick to him.

This is the ONLY detagler I'll use on my horses! reviews.t: Best detangler ever for long manes, just don't leave the bottle in the heat
reviews.x: This stuff is AMAZING! I have a draft that stays out in the field for the majority of his day and his mane can get really long. He's gone through burr patches, he's had dreadlocks, you name it, and this stuff works out all the knots and tangles. I even use it on my own hair sometimes. I only have to use a dime sized amount so it lasts forever too!  The only downside I can say is that the bottle lid pops up in the heat. I use to keep all my tack and supplies in my car and the bottle exploded (kin

reviews.t: Awesome product, a little goes a long way!
reviews.x: I've been using this product for years. Was given to me as a gift and I wouldn't go back to the other products I used to use: cowboy magic, showsheen, etc... I have a Canadian with LONG mane and tail. quarter size amount, rub in your hands and rub on mane or tail combing thru with your fingers... on knots put small amount on hands and rub in. Works great on dirty hair. Combs right out (start at bottom, work your way up). add more detangler if you need to but usually a little goes a long way.

reviews.t: Great Smelling, easy to apply and an Excellent Detangler
reviews.x: I used Cowboy Magic detangler for many years. it just seems to get more expensive every year. My horse trainer suggested Mane-Ly Long Hair Detangler when he was working with my very thick tailed half Freisian gelding. I tried it and I like it a lot. It is every bit as good as what I was using, and seems to last longer. A little goes a long way too. Cass's tail stays in great shape, with not a lot of effort.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise it as the best detangler they've tried, effectively removing tough knots and dreadlocks from manes and tails.
Many say it leaves hair silky, soft, and tangle-free for days or even weeks, with some noting it doesn't attract dirt or grease.
Several reviewers report success on thick, coarse, or double manes and tails, including on specific breeds like Icelandics, Haflingers, and Andalusians.
Some reviewers use it on their own hair or on dogs, showing it works beyond horses.
A few reviewers mention drawbacks: wishing it were a spray to avoid messy hands and wishing it were cheaper.
